layers.motifs.family.approved.json: only motifs meeting every promotion requirement

promotion_requirements: a measurable geometry or contact definition
prohibition: A family-specific motif may not be guessed into production in this phase. Candidate headings are evaluation topics, not a motif list.
core_vs_ligand_contact: Core activation motifs and ligand-recognition positions are different concepts and are kept in different config layers. A position such as 3x32 may be a ligand-contact anchor in the Aminergic family without being a Class A core activation motif.
